stations.name: Murmansk
stations.from: MURMANSK, RUSSIA. DOUBTFUL STATION. Schedule from "Worldwide Marine Radiofacsimile Broadcast Schedules" (NOAA, edition of March 7, 2025), which warns that the schedule "may no longer be transmitted on-air" and whose frequencies (5336, 6445.5, 7908.8, 10130 kHz) are old. Frequencies used here: 6328.5 and 8444 kHz, the ones the DX Info Centre list (W. R. Hepburn, 2025-03-17) gives as active or reported active, with the same times on the air as this schedule. The 1850 schedule is sent at 90 lines per minute; the rest 120/576.

stations.name: Athens
stations.from: ATHENS, GREECE. Hellenic National Meteorological Service. From "Worldwide Marine Radiofacsimile Broadcast Schedules" (NOAA, edition of March 7, 2025); information dated 01/2019. The source lists 4481 and 8105 kHz with the note "Center Frequency is 1.9 khz higher": the centres used here are 4482.9 and 8106.9 kHz. Other lists give 4481 and 8105 as the centres: if nothing is received, try those as a fixed frequency. The source prints this entry next to Murmansk's and the reader mixed them: the rows from 0845 to 1044 are taken as Athens' (they match the 0845-1055 window other lists give for it). All 120/576.
